name: Futu Exercises Incremental Merge
description: Futu 行权记录 base + 富途明细增量按行权订单编号幂等合并：base 是上月完整 to-date（含留空的历史订单号列），增量是富途平台导出的行权明细；按业务月截断后幂等合并，产出当月完整 base 供下游求和，并落盘固定路径供下月链式。

tasks.name: Extract Base Futu Exercises
tasks.description: 读取上月 Futu BCI Exercises base（14 列，第 1 行表头），输出文件保持相同契约，可跨月链式使用。

tasks.name: Extract Futu Exercise Increment

params.emptyColumns: 行权订单编号, 姓名, 工号, 牛牛号, 用户ID, 授予编号, 授予日期, 授予价(USD), 行权日期, 行权下单数量, 行权成功数量, 行权成本(USD), 扣除/卖出数量, 成交数量

tasks.description: 读取富途平台导出的员工行权记录『行权明细数据』sheet（59 列中文，第 1 行表头）。未提供该可选输入时输出带列契约的空 dataframe，由 base 独立成表。

tasks.name: Project Futu Increment to Base Contract

params.failureMessage: Futu increment schema changed: 缺少幂等键或行权日期列
params.expectedColumns: 行权订单编号, 姓名, 工号, 牛牛号, 用户ID, 授予编号, 授予日期, 授予价(USD), 行权日期, 行权下单数量, 行权成功数量, 行权成本(USD), 扣除/卖出数量, 成交数量

params.sql:
select
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([行权订单编号], '') as string)), '') as [Exercise Order No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], '') as string)), '') as [Name],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], '') as string)), '') as [Employee No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([牛牛号], '') as string)), '') as [Futubull ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([用户ID], '') as string)), '') as [User ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予编号], '') as string)), '') as [Grant No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予日期], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Date],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予价(USD)], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Price(USD)],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([行权日期], '') as string)), '') as [Exercise Date],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权下单数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([行权下单数量] as number) end as [Ordered Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成功数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([行权成功数量] as number) end as [Exercised Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成本(USD)], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([行权成本(USD)] as number) end as [Exercise Cost(USD)],
  case when cast(coalesce([扣除/卖出数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([扣除/卖出数量] as number) end as [Deduction/Selling Qty.],
  case when cast(coalesce([成交数量], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast([成交数量] as number) end as [Dealt Qty.]
from {increment}
where wf_month_key([行权日期]) is not null
  and wf_month_key([行权日期]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}
order by [行权日期], [行权订单编号]

tasks.description: 把富途 59 列明细投影成 base 的 14 列（中文→英文映射），"--" 空值归一为 0，并按 workflow 业务月截断行权日期。

tasks.name: Retain Base Rows Not Covered by Increment

params.failureMessage: Futu base schema changed: 缺少合并键或数量列
params.expectedColumns: Exercise Order No., Name, Employee No., Futubull ID, User ID, Grant No., Grant Date, Grant Price(USD), Exercise Date, Ordered Qty, Exercised Qty, Exercise Cost(USD), Deduction/Selling Qty., Dealt Qty.

params.sql:
select [Exercise Order No.], [Name], [Employee No.], [Futubull ID], [User ID], [Grant No.],
  [Grant Date], [Grant Price(USD)], [Exercise Date], [Ordered Qty], [Exercised Qty],
  [Exercise Cost(USD)], [Deduction/Selling Qty.], [Dealt Qty.]
from {base} b
where trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Exercise Order No.], '') as string)) <> ''
   or not exists (
     select 1 from {projected_increment} i
      where upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Grant No.], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Grant No.], '') as string)))
        and trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Exercise Date], '') as string)) = trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Exercise Date], '') as string))
   )

tasks.description: 保留 base 中未被富途增量取代的行：已带行权订单编号的行永久保留；空订单号的 legacy 行若增量里已有同 (Grant No., Exercise Date) 则视为被富途明细取代而丢弃，避免重复计算。

tasks.name: Merge Base and Increment Idempotently

params.failureMessage: Retained Futu base is missing a merge key column
params.expectedColumns: Exercise Order No., Grant No., Exercise Date, Exercised Qty

guards.name: Assert Futu Increment Has Order No

params.sql: select count(*) as actual from {increment} where [Exercise Order No.] is null or trim(cast([Exercise Order No.] as string)) = ''
params.failureMessage: Futu increment has rows without 行权订单编号; 幂等键不成立

guards.name: Assert Futu Increment Order No Unique

params.sql: select count(*) as actual from {increment} i where (select count(*) from {increment} d where d.[Exercise Order No.] = i.[Exercise Order No.]) > 1
params.failureMessage: Futu increment has duplicate 行权订单编号; 去重口径不明确

params.sql:
select
  case when i.[Exercise Order No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Exercise Order No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Exercise Order No.] else b.[Exercise Order No.] end as [Exercise Order No.],
  case when i.[Name] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Name] as string)) <> '' then i.[Name] else b.[Name] end as [Name],
  case when i.[Employee No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Employee No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Employee No.] else b.[Employee No.] end as [Employee No.],
  case when i.[Futubull ID] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Futubull ID] as string)) <> '' then i.[Futubull ID] else b.[Futubull ID] end as [Futubull ID],
  case when i.[User ID] is not null and trim(cast(i.[User ID] as string)) <> '' then i.[User ID] else b.[User ID] end as [User ID],
  case when i.[Grant No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Grant No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Grant No.] else b.[Grant No.] end as [Grant No.],
  case when i.[Grant Date] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Grant Date] as string)) <> '' then i.[Grant Date] else b.[Grant Date] end as [Grant Date],
  case when i.[Grant Price(USD)] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Grant Price(USD)] as string)) <> '' then i.[Grant Price(USD)] else b.[Grant Price(USD)] end as [Grant Price(USD)],
  case when i.[Exercise Date] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Exercise Date] as string)) <> '' then i.[Exercise Date] else b.[Exercise Date] end as [Exercise Date],
  case when i.[Ordered Qty] is not null then i.[Ordered Qty] else b.[Ordered Qty] end as [Ordered Qty],
  case when i.[Exercised Qty] is not null then i.[Exercised Qty] else b.[Exercised Qty] end as [Exercised Qty],
  case when i.[Exercise Cost(USD)] is not null then i.[Exercise Cost(USD)] else b.[Exercise Cost(USD)] end as [Exercise Cost(USD)],
  case when i.[Deduction/Selling Qty.] is not null then i.[Deduction/Selling Qty.] else b.[Deduction/Selling Qty.] end as [Deduction/Selling Qty.],
  case when i.[Dealt Qty.] is not null then i.[Dealt Qty.] else b.[Dealt Qty.] end as [Dealt Qty.]
from {retained_base} b
full outer join {projected_increment} i
  on upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Exercise Order No.], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Exercise Order No.], '') as string)))
order by coalesce(b.[Exercise Date], i.[Exercise Date]),
         coalesce(b.[Employee No.], i.[Employee No.]),
         coalesce(b.[__workflow_row_number], 1000000 + i.[__workflow_row_number])

tasks.description: 按行权订单编号 full outer join 幂等合并 retained base 与投影后的增量：同订单号去重（增量非空覆盖），空订单号的 legacy 行保留，按 Exercise Date / Employee No. 升序输出 14 列。
